Ieke Jjakkojin (seaweed, menma, spinach, onion, quail egg added)

Nani-yori is famous for being good at this!! I had high expectations but was a bit disappointed.
First of all, the soup is quite viscous and sticky.
I expected it to be an umami bomb because of its appearance, but it wasn't as rich as I thought.
The temperature of the soup was a little low and the saltiness was a bit high due to the above factors. I regretted ordering medium saltiness.
The noodles seemed to be the thinnest among all the restaurants I've tried. I didn't like it a bit, but the soup absorbed well.
The spinach and menma were decent.
Because of the balance of the soup, onions to give a little sweetness seemed essential (there is no additional charge for onions).
Why quail eggs?? I thought, I don't think I need to add it.
Among the toppings, seaweed and char siu were the best.
The char siu did not have a strong smoky flavor, so it tasted more like pork than ham.
The seaweed maintained its shape well even when soaked in soup and had a good scent.

Other than the taste, the lady owner is very friendly, and the table turnover is not fast, so the waiting time is as expected.
Next time, I'll have to order regular kkodeulhae and decide again.

reviews.author: Because he’s a genius
reviews.text:
Arguably, the hottest Ieke Ramen restaurant at the moment.
It opens at 17:30 on weekdays, so you can eat at 17:00, and waiting through tablets has started, but when I went at 16:45, there were already more than 10 people in line.
It's hard to even imagine on weekends.

When you enter the store, the kitchen is open, but it is a semi-open kitchen where you cannot see the cooking scene, and only a small number of seats are available around it.
Moreover, the turnover is not so fast that I, who entered at 5:30, received my ramen at 6:00, so waiting is a basic skill.
When you see the staff asking about the seasoning carefully even though they are busy, you nod your head in appreciation of their attention to detail.

Since it was my first visit, I went to Ieke (10,000 Won), which was the most popular dish. It was set with a lot of oil/salt/noodles.
Here's a tip: Eggs are not included, so be sure to add them if you like them.
It was unfortunate that the addition of char siu was blocked that evening (supply/demand issues?).

My first impression is that the clean plating and the logo on the bowl match the tone, so even though it is ramen, it looks pretty.
However, as if to show a twist, right from the first spoonful, three consecutive hits of greasy, salty, and heavy hit the uvula.
However, rather than being a sweet-salty broth, the rich flavor of the meat broth holds up, making it both ‘strong’ and ‘elegant’ at the same time.
When the soup becomes overly greasy, the spinach comes off like a reset button, and the undercooked noodles slide over in the lard.

However, the best play is determined.
Slurp on the provided seaweed with char siu, a few leaves of spinach, and even noodles - the moment you take a bite of this, you will understand why there are four pieces of seaweed, and next time you will think about adding more seaweed.
At this point, when you add another sip of soup, the feeling of the steam sticking to your tongue and then releasing and going down is addictive.

Inconvenient points such as waiting, seating, and rotation are clear and do not seem to be easily improved, but this is a place I already want to go back to.
Next time, I plan to go see ‘Another Extreme’ with a spicy taste.
The owner's efforts are reflected in the soup that has been pushed to the limit, so much so that you feel a little reverent as you eat it.

Review of Kim Tae-wan Sushi Songpa Main Branch 🍣

This was my first visit after only eating through delivery, and I immediately understood why Songpanaru Station is famous for its good restaurants. The store was clean and comfortable, and it was quieter than expected, so it was good to concentrate on the meal. There were a lot of customers even during weekday lunch, so I waited at a catch table before entering.

Omakase sushi has really good ingredients, and the seasoning of the shari is not too strong, bringing out the flavor of the raw fish well. The temperature of the rice was just right so it felt like it melted naturally in my mouth 👍 The course flow continued without pressure, so the overall quality felt high.

The extra rice I ordered exceeded my expectations! The sizzling part is savory, so I recommend trying this combination.

It's a sushi restaurant that sticks to the basics rather than being flashy, so it would be a good place to go on a date or take your parents. I intend to visit again 😊

A combination of tomatoes and ramen? ‘Sun’s Tomato Ramen’ I went in with doubts and came out impressed.
‘Wouldn’t it be strange to have noodles in hot tomato soup?’ I wanted to. But here, once you take a bite, those thoughts disappear.

It doesn't taste like ketchup, but the natural flavor of tomatoes mixed with the meat broth makes it really deep and refreshing. In fact, it is much cleaner than regular ramen, so I highly recommend it to those who do not like greasy food.

Those who drank alcohol yesterday! There is nothing like this for hangover. We all know that tomatoes are good for hangovers, right? I feel completely relieved.

Required Course: After eating all the noodles, be sure to add 'Cheese Risotto'. Mixing rice and cheese with the remaining tomato broth transforms it into a luxurious Italian dish.

If you are looking for a new and healthy taste other than the menu you always eat at Songnidan-gil, be sure to try it. “It makes me feel sorry for my prejudice!”
